expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Writes a standard message to the named log category. Writes an informational message to the named log category. Writes a display-level message to the named log category. Writes an error message to the named log category. Writes a warning message to the named log category. Writes a standard message to the named category only when Condition is true. Writes an informational message to the named category only when Condition is true. Writes a display-level message to the named category only when Condition is true. Writes an error message to the named category only when Condition is true. Writes a warning message to the named category only when Condition is true.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
